queries_run: Fabrinet market share optical transceiver EMS gaining losing 2026
Fabrinet new entrant competitor optical manufacturing displace threat 2026
Fabrinet competitor design win 2026 Jabil Coherent Lumentum optical assembly

findings.claim: 全球具備 400G/800G 高良率量產能力的精密光學 EMS 對手不到十家，支撐 Fabrinet 的訂價紀律與毛利；高複雜度端進入門檻反而升高（低階則變容易），Fabrinet 在最高複雜度端的位置最具防禦性。
findings.source: MatrixBCG — 'What is Competitive Landscape of Fabrinet Company?' (https://matrixbcg.com/blogs/competitors/fabrinet)

findings.claim: Celestica、Jabil（營收逾 $30B）等大型 EMS 正加碼投資承接光學複雜度，客戶端同步推動雙源認證（dual-source qualification），對 Fabrinet 形成訂價與全球布局競爭壓力。
findings.source: MatrixBCG — 'What is Competitive Landscape of Fabrinet Company?' (https://matrixbcg.com/blogs/competitors/fabrinet)

findings.claim: 新進入者 UMC 已取得 imec iSiPP300 矽光子製程授權，計畫 2026-2027 年展開風險量產（risk production），屬矽光子製造端的新對手；另有越南、印度新進業者在中低階價格帶施壓，但缺乏 Fabrinet 的精密無塵室工藝能力。
findings.source: MatrixBCG — 'What is Competitive Landscape of Fabrinet Company?' (https://matrixbcg.com/blogs/competitors/fabrinet)

findings.claim: Fabrinet 本質為純代工製造夥伴（不做元件設計），Lumentum、Coherent 則同時是設計商與製造商——三者在光通訊供應鏈中定位不同，Lumentum、Coherent 對 Fabrinet 而言更接近客戶/合作關係而非直接製造產能競爭對手。
findings.source: Zacks via Yahoo Finance — 'The Best AI Stocks to Buy for 2026 (LITE, COHR, FN)' (https://finance.yahoo.com/news/best-ai-stocks-buy-2026-164600902.html)

queries_run: Fabrinet Nvidia largest customer second source in-house optics 2026
Nvidia Cisco custom optics second source agreement 2026 co-packaged optics in-house
Fabrinet single-source risk customer diversify supplier Nvidia Cisco 10-K

findings.claim: Fabrinet 前大客戶集中度逐年變動：FY2024 NVIDIA 35.1%／Cisco 13.4%；FY2025 NVIDIA 27.6%／Cisco 18.2%；FY2026 轉為 Cisco 20%／NVIDIA 16%／Nokia 11%／Amazon 11%（四家合計占營收 57%）——NVIDIA 占比連兩年下滑、Cisco 躍居第一大客戶，客戶結構轉向多元但集中度本身未降。
findings.source: Fabrinet FY2026 Form 10-K（SEC EDGAR，https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001408710/000140871026000028/fn-20260626.htm）；數字彙整見 StockTitan 'Fabrinet (NYSE: FN) lifts 2026 sales 35.7% but 4 customers supply 57%'

findings.claim: 查無 Cisco 或 NVIDIA 就 Fabrinet 製造環節導入第二供應商（second-source）或宣布自製（in-house）的具體公告；NVIDIA 官方與產業報導僅涉及其自身 CPO 交換器產品線的元件生態（下游客戶面臨事實上單一供應局面），未提及 Fabrinet 代工環節被繞過。
findings.source: TechTimes — 'Nvidia Ships Co-Packaged Optics Switch as Ecosystem Testing Gap Widens' (https://www.techtimes.com/articles/324160/20260812/nvidia-ships-co-packaged-optics-switch-ecosystem-testing-gap-widens.htm)；IDTechEx — 'Co-Packaged Optics Race: Strategic Approaches from NVIDIA and Broadcom' (https://www.idtechex.com/en/research-article/co-packaged-optics-race-strategic-approaches-from-nvidia-and-broadcom/34467)

findings.claim: Fabrinet 10-K 揭露的競爭來源包含『在特定客戶端已通過認證的其他委外代工廠』與『OEM 客戶自身的自製（in-house）產能』兩類，為既有揭露風險而非本季新增事件。
